observation.command:
cat > /workspace/.build-logs/wave2.sh <<'ORCHEOF'
#!/bin/bash
ROOT=/workspace
LOGS=$ROOT/.build-logs
STAGE=$LOGS/stage
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
PAR=2
RESULTS=$LOGS/results2
: > $RESULTS
PYIMG=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

# name<TAB>service-dir<TAB>extra-dep-dirs(csv)
cat > $LOGS/services2.tsv <<'EOF'
berichtskonfigurator	02-backend/berichtskonfigurator	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
decision-log-store-service	02-backend/decision-log-store-service	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol
demos-einwendungsmanagement	02-backend/demos-einwendungsmanagement	03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-security
dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service	02-backend/dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging
dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo	02-backend/dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
dokumentenpruefung	02-backend/dokumentenpruefung	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator	02-backend/dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol
dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector	02-backend/dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector	03-shared-services/ki-logging
dokumentensuche	02-backend/dokumentensuche	03-shared-services/bizlog
graph-api	02-backend/graph-api	03-shared-services/ki-logging
ki-guv-ai-testing	02-backend/ki-guv-ai-testing	03-shared-services/ki-logging
ki-guv-explainability	02-backend/ki-guv-explainability	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader
ki-guv-feedback	02-backend/ki-guv-feedback	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/ki-logging
kommentar-service	02-backend/kommentar-service	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol
nachforderungen	02-backend/nachforderungen	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol
ner-extraction	02-backend/ner-extraction	03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
norm-matching	02-backend/norm-matching	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
rechtsquellenvorbereitung	02-backend/rechtsquellenvorbereitung	02-backend/tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction,03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
request-proxy	02-backend/request-proxy	03-shared-services/bizlog
risikohinweis-service	02-backend/risikohinweis-service	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
subsumtion-service	02-backend/subsumtion-service	03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security
tex2pdf-service	02-backend/tex2pdf-service	03-shared-services/bizlog
ki-validierung	03-shared-services/ki-validierung	03-shared-services/prompt-loader
demospipes-bmds-api	02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds	02-backend/demospipes/data-structures
demospipes-bmds-executors	02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds	02-backend/demospipes/data-structures
EOF

build_svc() {
  local name="$1"
  local d="$STAGE/$name"
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
    --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=$DUMMY_USER \
    --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=$DUMMY_TOKEN \
    -t "$name" "$d" >> "$LOGS/w2-$name.log" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  echo "$rc $name" >> $RESULTS
  echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] built $name rc=$rc" >> $LOGS/wave2.log
}

local_wheels() {
  local d="$1"; shift
  mkdir -p "$d/local-wheels"
  for sub in "$@"; do
    ( cd "$d/$sub" && timeout 300 uv build --wheel --out-dir "$d/local-wheels" >> "$LOGS/wave2-relock.log" 2>&1 ) || echo "WHEELFAIL $d/$sub" >> $LOGS/wave2.log
  done
}

stage_and_queue() {
  local name="$1" svcdir="$2" deps="$3"
  local d="$STAGE/$name"
  local cd="${d/\/workspace/\/w}"
  rm -rf "$d" && mkdir -p "$d"
  rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude '.venv' --exclude '__pycache__' "$ROOT/$svcdir/" "$d/"
  IFS=',' read -ra arr <<< "$deps"
  for dep in "${arr[@]}"; do
    [ -z "$dep" ] && continue
    rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude '.venv' --exclude '__pycache__' "$ROOT/$dep/" "$d/$(basename "$dep")/"
  done
  if [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] || ls "$d"/*/pyproject.toml >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/rewrite_paths.py "$cd" >> "$LOGS/wave2-relock.log" 2>&1 || true
    ( cd "$d" && timeout 300 uv lock >> "$LOGS/wave2-relock.log" 2>&1 )
  fi
  # patch Dockerfile: ensure COPY . before uv sync in each builder stage
  docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py "$cd" >> "$LOGS/wave2-relock.log" 2>&1
  # demospipes bmds addons: base image tags + local wheels + pip wheel fix
  case "$name" in
    demospipes-bmds-api|demospipes-bmds-executors)
      sed -i -E 's|^FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-api:.*|FROM demospipes-base-api|; s|^FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-executors:.*|FROM demospipes-base-executors|' "$d/Dockerfile"
      local_wheels "$d" data-structures data_structures
      docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/fix_pipwheel.py "$cd/Dockerfile" >> "$LOGS/wave2-relock.log" 2>&1
      ;;
  esac
  build_svc "$name" &
  echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] started $name" >> $LOGS/wave2.log
}

queue=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name svcdir deps; do
  queue+=("$name|$svcdir|$deps")
done < $LOGS/services2.tsv

for item in "${queue[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r name svcdir deps <<< "$item"
  while [ $(jobs -rp | wc -l) -ge $PAR ]; do sleep 10; done
  stage_and_queue "$name" "$svcdir" "$deps"
done
wait
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] WAVE2 DONE" >> $LOGS/wave2.log
ORCHEOF
chmod +x /workspace/.build-logs/wave2.sh
# quick unit test of patcher on a COPY.-before-sync Dockerfile (tex2pdf: test-deps copies specific files)
rm -rf /tmp/pt2 && cp -r /workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service /tmp/pt2
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w -v /tmp/pt2:/pt ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py /pt
grep -n 'WORKDIR\|COPY . \|uv sync\|COPY pyproject' /tmp/pt2/Dockerfile | head -12; rm -rf /tmp/pt2
